channel.title: Pysano Updates
channel.description: Stable and beta updates for Pysano.

item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0
- Refreshed settings, tabs, buttons and model selectors with clearer local/cloud labels. - Ask about selected text or screenshots by voice or keyboard, preview the result and continue with temporary follow-up questions. Review the original question and captured image alongside the answer. - Choose the model for text commands, image questions and quick translation; manage downloaded text/image models and optional dictation proofreading. - More local speech models and additional dictation sound styles, including keyboard, typewriter and water sounds. - Translate selected text or a captured screen area, with separate default languages for text and images. Change the target language in the result without capturing the source again. - Use local or Gemini cloud models for note transcription and summaries. Add, edit and remove Gemini model profiles using the existing Gemini key. - Move an entire note recording to the macOS Trash after confirmation. Audio, transcript, summary and working files stay together; external exports are preserved. - Updated Argmax/WhisperKit to 1.1.1, including crash and canceled-download fixes and removal of automatic Hugging Face token-file reads. - Updated Sparkle to 2.10.1, including the Unicode-path premature-installation fix and missing Ukrainian updater translations. - Updated audio-permission descriptions to explain explicitly selected cloud note processing.
Stable release: locally signed, not notarized by Apple.
This Stable uses the established Pysano certificate and Sparkle EdDSA update key. It is not Developer ID notarized; a fresh Mac may block installation through Gatekeeper. No system security settings are changed. Existing keys, local models, settings and recordings are retained. Review the Known issues included with the app for acceptance limits and cloud quota behavior.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.38
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0-beta.38
Experimental beta: not notarized by Apple.
- Added three downloadable local speech models: Parakeet ReDux, Phonon 2.5 multilingual and NVIDIA Canary 1B v2. Manage downloads under Models and choose a model under Dictation. - ReDux is labelled Compact. Phonon and Canary are labelled Experimental, with guidance about GPU use, memory and language selection. These models require macOS 15 or later. - Canary uses the selected transcription language. Automatic and Ukrainian + English use a Ukrainian hint. Choose English for English-only recordings. - Fixed duplicate selection checkmarks in model, language and other dropdown lists. - Corrected the installed Ukrainian Parakeet model name to UK v3 and clarified the Ukrainian + English setting for mixed speech. - Updated the local speech runtime and preserved the installed model packages for existing users.

# Pysano 0.7.1
- The **Repair Key Access** action now rebuilds the legacy Keychain item's ACL once for Pysano's stable code signature, preventing an unlock prompt on every launch. - The API key remains in Keychain; there are no automatic system prompts and the key is never saved to project files. - Added four feedback sound sets: Liquid, Soft Chime, Pulse, and macOS System. - Liquid is the new default short cue. Every option can be previewed in Settings without starting a recording, and sound feedback can still be disabled completely.

# Pysano 0.7.0
- Made the dictation indicator smaller and moved its default position to the top so it does not cover the input field. - Added top, bottom, left, and right indicator placement options. - The completion message can be hidden or displayed for 0.5, 1, 2, or 4 seconds; the default is 1 second. - Added native macOS sounds at recording start and completion, with a separate sound toggle.
